meta.name: Vertical Multistage Centrifugal Pump (VCMP) curve database
meta.curve_basis: Digitized 60 Hz vertical multistage centrifugal pump regressions supplied by the user.
meta.affinity_laws: Q∝r; H∝r²; P∝r³. Efficiency is evaluated at homologous flow Q/r from the 60 Hz efficiency regression.
meta.rpm_note: The supplied workbook does not include a manufacturer reference shaft RPM. Total RO Design therefore reports VFD frequency and speed ratio; shaft torque is calculated only when a reference RPM is supplied in a future database revision.
